headline: Agriculture Minister Amran says fortified rice case triggered rice price rises for six consecutive months
summary: Indonesian Agriculture Minister Amran said the fortified rice case is one of the triggers for rice price increases over six consecutive months. No further details were provided in the input.
why: Rice is a staple food in Indonesia, so sustained price rises affect inflation, household spending and government food policy.
